meaning:
πατριάρχης, -ου, ὁ

a patriarch: Act.2:29 7:8-9, Heb.7:4.†

elsewhere.note: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
